appearance_anchors.construction: Use circumscribed polygons (apothem at least parent outer radius). Add only outside the immutable parent solid and protected sweep.

geometry_contract.formula: G_new = G_parent union A_safe; A_safe is a connected subset of proposed additions outside protected execution sweep S.
geometry_contract.protected_sweep: Conservative continuous sweep of ball and ALL robot collision bodies over planned motion, grasp closure, both saved physical runs, placement, gripper opening and retreat; include an explicit 1 mm additional design margin.
must_not_change: C twist handedness and guide coupling
physics friction or mass of moving bodies
geometry_contract.proof_scope: If A_safe is disjoint from the certified swept volume, the same geometric solution remains. Superset geometry preserves the existing finite collision witnesses. A new physical run is still required; visual separation and structural connectivity are separate acceptance conditions.

motion_search.default: Freeze parent motion for the first appearance batch.

appearance_gate.require: Visible silhouette/profile differences and preserved visible family mechanism; final mesh must meet the ratio, octagonal-face and opening visibility targets. Reject if sweep trimming destroys these features.
appearance_gate.metrics: R_mid/R_end>=1.12 for barrel; eight discernible facets and waist/shoulder apothem 0.80–0.90 for octagonal waist; mask differences are supporting measurements, not a substitute for inspection.

randomization_contract.appearance_distribution: uniform among admitted prototypes within family
randomization_contract.continuous_parameters: joint conditional samples, not an independently certified Cartesian product
randomization_contract.initial_generator_mode: select from the admitted geometry/motion bank, then vary visual material only
randomization_contract.later_generator_mode: sample motion only when enabled, solve its branch continuously, infer geometry, apply appearance, validate, reject failures; admit only at explicitly recorded evidence level
randomization_contract.on_exhaustion: return no admissible sample with failure reasons; never return an unverified candidate as solved
randomization_contract.split_group: family motion parent plus functional geometry; appearance siblings stay in the same train/validation split
